caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped plaque with a dark, metallic appearance. At the center, there is a tall, hexagonal fire hydrant-like structure, rendered in shades of grey, with a long hose or serpent coiled around it and laying across stylized leafy or flame-like elements at the base, also shaded in grey. The plaque has two circular holes, one at the top and one at the bottom, likely for mounting. On each side of the hydrant structure are large embossed letters, “F” on the left and “A” on the right. Near the bottom of the plaque, the numbers “12401” are visible in a lighter grey, suggesting they are either painted or engraved. The background and border of the plaque are a textured dark grey, and the entire image is centered on a plain, off-white rectangular background.
title: Firemark
